kjv: Neither as being lords over God's heritage
mine: not domineering over those in your charge
note: ton kleron are the portions (congregations) allotted to each elder; "God's heritage" (KJV) is an interpretation. The source of the word "clergy", ironically here applied to the laity.

kjv: Peace [be] with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
mine: Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
